hooks.name: New endpoint checklist
hooks.description: When a NestJS controller file is saved, remind to add Swagger decorators, create corresponding frontend API hook, and regenerate OpenAPI spec

action.prompt: A NestJS controller has been modified. Ensure: 1) Every method has @ApiOperation, @ApiResponse, @ApiTags decorators. 2) Request bodies use ZodValidationPipe with shared schemas. 3) Path params use ParseUUIDPipe. 4) A corresponding frontend API function exists in apps/web/src/lib/api.ts. 5) The OpenAPI spec should be regenerated after all endpoint changes are complete.
